key.name: speeds
key.description: A factor on each shader's normal speed, remembered per shader. 1.0 is normal, lower is slower, higher is faster. Only shaders that have been adjusted appear here.

key.name: fps-cap
key.description: How often the background is redrawn each second. Lower values draw less and use less power; the background still animates, just less smoothly.

key.name: auto-downscale
key.summary: Draw demanding shaders at a lower resolution
key.description: Some shaders are far more work to draw than others. When this is on, each one is timed once and the demanding ones are drawn at half or a quarter of the screen's resolution and scaled back up, which looks slightly softer and costs a great deal less. Shaders that can keep up are left at full resolution.

key.name: frame-budget
key.summary: Share of a frame a shader may take
key.description: How much of the time between two frames the background is allowed to spend drawing, as a percentage. The rest is what the compositor has left for everything else. Lower values keep the graphics card idle more of the time, at the cost of drawing more shaders at a lower resolution. Only has an effect while shaders are timed.

key.name: scales
key.summary: The resolution each shader was found to manage
key.description: What the timing came out at, remembered per shader and per screen resolution so it is not measured again at every login. Clearing this makes every shader be timed afresh.

key.name: pause-fullscreen
key.summary: Pause while a window is fullscreen
key.description: Stop animating the background while a fullscreen window covers the screen, so nothing is spent drawing something nobody can see.

key.name: override-index
key.description: Which shader to show instead of today's. -1 follows the daily rotation.

key.name: override-day
key.description: A hand-picked shader lasts until midnight. This records the day it was picked, so the choice expires on its own.
